name: Cove Beach ADU
role: Lead carpentry subcontractor for West Coast Turn Key
description: A detached accessory dwelling unit built alongside the main Cove Beach residence, set into the same rock bluff above the ocean. Renova delivered the mitered cedar rainscreen siding with true waterfall corners on the ADU's exterior.
